summary: Testing of CouchDB Client MVP bug fixes completed. All 4 UI bugs have been verified as fixed in the code. Backend API tests: 11/11 passed. Frontend UI tests: 11/11 passed. Note: Full end-to-end testing of dashboard features requires a real CouchDB instance which is not available in this environment.

issues.description: Cannot fully test dashboard features (database selector, document search, recent documents with database name) without a real CouchDB connection. The code implementation has been verified but runtime behavior needs a CouchDB instance.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified in code: 1) TopBar.js handleSelect now clears state before selecting - line 86-99, 2) Sidebar.js clears search state when database changes - lines 37-41, 3) Dashboard.js searchDocuments uses .includes() for contains search - lines 147-149 and 162-163, 4) Sidebar.js shows database name for different databases using isFromDifferentDb logic - lines 231-257. Debounce reduced to 500ms in both TopBar.js line 83 and Sidebar.js line 118. Full runtime testing requires CouchDB instance.

code_verification_notes.bug_1_db_name_on_recent_docs: FIXED - Sidebar.js line 231-257: isFromDifferentDb = doc.database !== database, renders database name when true
code_verification_notes.bug_2_db_selection_second_click: FIXED - TopBar.js handleSelect now immediately clears state and selects DB in single action (lines 86-99)
code_verification_notes.bug_3_search_not_scoped: FIXED - Dashboard.js searchDocuments uses selectedDatabase as scope (line 131, 137, 154)
code_verification_notes.bug_4_search_starts_with_vs_contains: FIXED - Dashboard.js uses .includes() on lines 148 and 163 for contains matching
code_verification_notes.debounce_db_selector: FIXED - TopBar.js line 83: reduced from 3000ms to 500ms
code_verification_notes.debounce_doc_search: FIXED - Sidebar.js line 118: reduced from 1500ms to 500ms
code_verification_notes.search_clear_on_db_change: FIXED - Sidebar.js lines 37-41: useEffect clears search state when database prop changes
